# Realistic agent shell commands, one per line. Controlled vocabulary: no
# spaces inside a single argument, so a whitespace split plus quote-stripping
# reconstructs each Command without a shell parser.
grep -rn parseGuardCommands .
grep -rn evaluateBashGuard internal/
grep -rnw Suggestion .
grep -rn MGS1002 .
grep -rn MGS4007 docs/
grep -rn mgs_listManifests spells/
grep -rn mgs_readFile .
grep -rni todo internal/
grep -rn -e alpha -e beta .
grep -rn 'func(x)' .
rg parseQuery
rg -w NewGraph internal/hint
rg -t go suggestSearch
rg -F 'TODO(eli)'
rg -g '*.go' bareIdentRe
ag translateSearch
ag -G '.go$' someHelperName
rg cache_key
grep -R KindDocSection types
grep -rn magus.query.output .
grep -f patterns.txt -r .
grep -r -e alpha -F -e beta .
grep -n install README.md
grep -rn checkpoint docs/guides/vcs.md
rg docsection MAGUS.md
ag adoption docs/recommendations.md
grep pattern go.mod
grep -n version magus.yaml
grep -c func main.go
find . -name '*.go'
find internal -name '*_test.go'
find . -name '*.buzz' -exec wc -l {} ;
find docs -type f -name '*.md'
find . -type d
fd -e go
fd -e buzz spells
fd guard_ cmd/magus
fd -g '*.yaml'
find . -name '[ab]*.go'
cat MAGUS.md
cat internal/hint/hint.go
head -50 cmd/magus/guard_shell.go
tail -20 .magus/logs/run.log
less docs/index.md
more go.sum
bat internal/agent/doc.go
sed -n 10,20p magusfile.buzz
awk '{print$1}' go.sum
sed s/foo/bar/ notes.txt
sed -i s/a/b/g config.yaml
sd foo bar internal/
awk -F: '{print$2}' /etc/passwd
ls -la internal/hint
wc -l internal/hint/hint.go
tree -L 2
du -sh .magus
